:::{#exm-deriv-lincom-tp}
#### Derivative of a transpose product

Let $\vx = \tp{(3, 5)}$ and $\vcoef = \tp{(\coef{1}, \coef{2})}$.
Then $\tp{\vx}\vcoef = 3\coef{1} + 5\coef{2}$, and by @cor-deriv-lincom-tp:

$$
\underbrace{\deriv{\vcoef}\left(\underbrace{\tp{\vx}}_{1 \times 2}\underbrace{\vcoef}_{2 \times 1}\right)}_{2 \times 1}
= \underbrace{\vx}_{2 \times 1}
= \begin{pmatrix} 3 \\
5 \end{pmatrix}
$$

:::
